scope: No-model, no-Chisel-activation retirement map for the Review-03 testbench ingress and static-fixture boundaries. It names future responsibility without changing an owner, carrier, top, scheduler, authority, memory/numeric realization, or physical implementation.
inherited_rules: R3/M2 is the only metadata-publication and pending-to-packed authority boundary; R5 owns page and descriptor facts.
R2/R1 remains the only typed delivery/request/response/FIFO/credit owner; functional memory is non-authoritative.
hot/direct-pending/S2 supply K/V-sideband identity/generation but do not create attention partials merely by storage ownership.
RTL3.5-A partial-provider and RTL3.4-B R4 boundaries remain frozen; canonical hot->pending->packed order and R6 terminal ownership remain unchanged.

I0.forbidden: binder must not select a scheduler or create a conflicting live association

I1.consumer: association owner and S2 service path
I1.forbidden: no second publication or authority transition

I3.forbidden: no slot/generation inference from page ID or test default

I4.current: RTL3.6-C1 sidecar fixture plus verification S2 sidecar ingress
I4.forbidden: payload traffic may not infer sidecar completion

I5.future_owner: activation binder plus existing typed-delivery path
I5.forbidden: no new scheduler or arbitration policy

I6.future_owner: existing R6 direct-pending plan and endpoint-local state
I6.forbidden: must not be conflated with packed C2 activation

I7.current: static RTL3.6-B packet/terminal fixture and manual packet/result harness ingress
I7.future_owner: dynamic functional partial provider and dynamic functional R4 provider

I8.current: structural top source and R4 tie-offs
I8.future_owner: replaceable partial/R4 boundary or declared synthesis blackbox
I8.forbidden: tie-off on an exercised functional source path

allowed_outer_environments: route_a_functional_memory_environment supplies only accepted core_mem_if_v1 init and response/terminal behavior
route_a_functional_attention_partial_provider supplies only dynamic partial packets after accepted source/query leases
route_a_functional_r4_merge_provider supplies only dynamic success XOR numeric fault after accepted packets and R6 work
